title: Do not manufacture human errors
rule: Do not add typos, tangents or invented details to imitate a human.
example: Preserve the supported result and the writer’s actual qualification.
counterexample: Add a deliberate typo and an invented personal story to sound human.
rationale: Fabricated mistakes and details damage meaning and accuracy.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/ne-fac/_template/general.md`. Examples are illustrative.
